mapper.select: SELECT s.commodity_id, c.name AS commodity_name, s.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, s.quantity, s.unit_price, s.amount FROM stock s JOIN commodity c ON c.id = s.commodity_id JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id ORDER BY c.name, w.name, c.id, w.id

SELECT COALESCE(s.quantity, 0) AS quantity, COALESCE(s.unit_price, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(24, 6))) AS unit_price, COALESCE(s.amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(20, 2))) AS amount FROM commodity c CROSS JOIN warehouse w LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.commodity_id = c.id AND s.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE c.id = #{commodityId} AND w.id = #{warehouseId} AND c.is_deleted = FALSE AND w.is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock (commodity_id, warehouse_id, quantity, unit_price, amount) VALUES (#{pair.commodityId}, #{pair.warehouseId}, #{balance.quantity}, #{balance.unitPrice}, #{balance.amount}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = incoming.quantity, unit_price = incoming.unit_price, amount = incoming.amount
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stock WHERE commodity_id = #{commodityId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
mapper.select: SELECT GREATEST( UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), COALESCE((SELECT TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND, 1, MAX(created_at)) FROM stock_in WHERE commodity_id = #{commodityId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), COALESCE((SELECT TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND, 1, MAX(created_at)) FROM stock_out WHERE commodity_id = #{commodityId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) )

SELECT id, FALSE AS outbound, quantity, unit_price, amount, created_at, previous_quantity, previous_unit_price, previous_amount FROM stock_in WHERE commodity_id = #{commodityId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} UNION ALL SELECT id, TRUE AS outbound, quantity, unit_price, amount, created_at, previous_quantity, previous_unit_price, previous_amount FROM stock_out WHERE commodity_id = #{commodityId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} ORDER BY created_at, outbound, id
